name: Khata Tax Advisory
tagline: Tax filing for Pakistani freelancers paid from abroad — done properly, explained plainly.

essence.mission: Help freelancers who earn in dollars keep more of it, legally, without dreading the FBR.
essence.story: Khata is the Urdu word for a ledger. The brand borrows the calm of a well-kept account book: ruled lines, careful figures, and a double underline under the total.
essence.audience: Freelancers and remote workers in Pakistan paid via Upwork, Fiverr, Payoneer and Wise; mostly on phones, often anxious about notices and deadlines.

is: Calm and exact, like a good accountant
Specific — real rates, real deadlines, real fees

logo.concept: A K built from ledger strokes, resting on the accountant's double underline — the mark that means 'this total is final'.

colors.name: Paper
colors.notes: Default page background. Warm, never pure white.

colors.name: Ledger Ink
colors.notes: Body text, headings, rules under totals.

colors.name: Ledger Green
colors.notes: The one accent: primary actions, links, the logo on light backgrounds.

colors.name: Debit Red
colors.notes: Only for money lost, missed deadlines, errors.

families.name: Newsreader
families.why: An editorial serif with ledger-like seriousness; signals an established, careful firm without feeling corporate.

families.name: Public Sans
families.why: Plain, highly legible on cheap Android screens; designed for public-service clarity.

families.name: JetBrains Mono
families.why: For figures in fee tables and worked examples — distinct 0/O and 1/l.

scale.sample: Send one bank statement and your platform payout history. We'll tell you, in writing, what you owe and what you can save.
Rates per Finance Act 2026; confirm before filing.

scripts.sample: کھاتہ — فری لانسرز کے لیے ٹیکس فائلنگ

rules: Headlines in Newsreader, never all caps. Body in Public Sans at 17px+.
All money uses tabular figures; right-align amounts in tables.
Urdu text gets line-height ≥ 2 and is never squeezed into Latin leading.
Max two weights per family on any page.

icons.style: Thin outline icons on a 24px grid, used beside labels — never alone, never in colored circles.
rules: One library (Lucide), one stroke (1.5px), one size per context.
Icons accompany text; they never replace a label.
No emoji anywhere in the product or marketing.

imagery.approach: Real documents and real people at work in Lahore — paper, phones, payouts. If we can't photograph it honestly, we use a worked example instead.
do: Photograph the actual team and office
Use worked number examples as hero images

layout.grid: 12-column grid, 1200px max width; text columns capped at 68 characters. Generous space between sections, tight within groups.
rules: Prefer rules and bands over cards.
Left-align text; center only single short lines.

principles.title: Specific over impressive
principles.body: Quote the rate, the fee, the deadline. Numbers build more trust than adjectives.

principles.title: Plain, then precise
principles.body: Say it simply first, then give the exact legal term in brackets.

principles.title: Calm about deadlines
principles.body: Urgency without panic — tell people what to do next.

we_say: File your 2026 return for Rs 6,500, fixed.
Registered with PSEB? Your rate drops to 0.25%.
Missed 30 September? Here's what to do this week.
we_dont_say: Revolutionizing tax for the next generation

guardrails: No purple/blue gradients, glassmorphism, glows or blurred blobs.
No emoji icons, no icon-in-gradient-square feature cards.
No fake testimonials or invented client counts.
No centered hero + three feature cards template.
Never present tax figures without the source year.
